why: A fixture whose provenance is unknown is a fixture nobody can trust on the day it disagrees with them. Every file under fixtures/ppa/ is listed here with where it came from, what property it carries, and the sha256 it had when that property was verified. test_ppa_fixture_integrity.py fails if a file is edited, if a file appears without an entry, or if any listed property stops holding.
note_on_absent_paths: vacuous/absent_report.rpt is NOT listed and must NOT exist. It is a fixture that works by not being there; see vacuous/README.md.
